title: 第1925章 放心大胆的去干第1924章 巴林家族
slug: 噬神塔第1929章小金的战力
lines: “刚刚那人是谁？”
进入巴林城，热闹非凡，周围到处都是摊贩的叫卖声，秦易能清晰的感应到，往来的修行者气息都很强盛。
不愧是巴林家族，这种老牌家族的底蕴，不是一般势力能够比拟的。
“他是我们这一辈的老九，名叫胡云。”
“需不需要我出手解决掉他？”秦易随意问道。
额！
胡鸣连连摆手，胡云不可怕，可怕的是胡云背后的势力。
他可是大长老派系的人，一旦动了他，大长老不会放过他的。
噔噔噔！
不知不觉中，胡鸣便将秦易安置在了一个僻静的院落之中。
“秦先生，你先在这里休息，我跟敏姐去一趟城主府。”
安置好秦易后，凌敏跟胡鸣便急匆匆的来到了城主府。
守卫看到凌敏之后，立即放行，并且将他们两人，引导到了花园之中。
花园中。
一位浑身散发着上位者气息的中年男子，他坐在石凳上品茶，在他旁边坐着的，则是一位手持火红色权杖的老者。
“父亲。”
凌敏突然出声叫道。
看到凌敏毫发无伤的回到巴林家族，身为父亲的族长，脸上也是露出了激动笑容。
“敏儿，你没事吧？”巴林族长立即上前，查探情况。
“父亲，我没事，这一次多亏了胡鸣，否则的话，我就凶多吉少了。”凌敏说道。
这是她之前跟秦易商量好的。
即便将这个功劳给秦易，他毕竟是一个外人，也得不到什么。
与其这样，不如让胡鸣揽下功劳，这对他以后的竞争，有很大的好处。
“鸣儿也回来了？”
巴林族长满意的对胡鸣点了点头。
然而就在这时，手持火红色拐杖的老者，冷哼一声，一股无形的威压，瞬间笼罩胡鸣。
“大胆胡鸣。”
大长老起身，怒斥胡鸣，“我刚刚得到消息，是胡云找到凌敏的，你为何要撒谎？”
嗯？
此言一出，连凌敏本人都有些愣神。
而后，他直接反驳大长老，说道：“大长老，我确确实实是被胡鸣救的……”
“胡鸣什么实力，他能救的了你？”
大长老当然知道真相，可他为了针对胡鸣，压根就不管真相。
“你莫不是为了让他重回家族，故意这样说的？”
嗡！
恐怖的威压，不断挤压胡鸣的身体，咔嚓一声，清脆的声音从胡鸣身体中传出。
能看得出来，他正在承受着极大的痛苦。
就在这时，巴林族长开口制止了，“大长老，这件事情我会调查清楚的……”
“救下敏儿，这是大功一件，在没有调查清楚之前，我不会做出任何奖赏。”
闻言，大长老这才挥动手中火红色拐杖，无形威压瞬间消失。
“胡鸣，你不是已经离开巴林城了吗，为何要回来？”大长老质问道。
短暂的寂静过后，胡鸣抬头，直视大长老。
content_en:
"Who was that person just now?"
Entering the city of Bahrain, it was very lively, with the cries of vendors everywhere. Qin Yi could clearly sense that the auras of the practitioners coming and going were very strong.
As expected of the Bahrain family, the heritage of such a long-established family cannot be matched by ordinary forces.
"He is the ninth oldest of our generation, and his name is Hu Yun."
"Do you need me to take action to deal with him?" Qin Yi asked casually.
Forehead!
Hu Ming waved his hands repeatedly, Hu Yun is not scary, what is scary is the power behind Hu Yun.
He is from the Great Elder's faction. Once he is touched, the Great Elder will not let him go.
Thump thump thump!
Unknowingly, Hu Ming placed Qin Yi in a secluded courtyard.
"Mr. Qin, you rest here first. Sister Min and I will go to the City Lord's Mansion."
After Qin Yi was settled, Ling Min and Hu Ming hurried to the City Lord's Mansion.
After the guard saw Ling Min, he immediately let them go and guided the two of them into the garden.
in the garden.
A middle-aged man who exuded the aura of a superior person was sitting on a stone bench sipping tea. Sitting next to him was an old man holding a fiery red scepter.
"Father."
Ling Min suddenly shouted.
Seeing Ling Min return to the Bahrain family unscathed, the patriarch, the father, also had an excited smile on his face.
"Min'er, are you okay?" The Bahrain chief immediately stepped forward to investigate the situation.
"Father, I'm fine, thanks to Hu Ming this time. Otherwise, I would have been in trouble." Ling Min said.
This was what she had discussed with Qin Yi before.
Even if the credit is given to Qin Yi, he is an outsider after all and will not get much.
Rather than doing this, it is better to let Hu Ming take the credit, which will be of great benefit to his future competition.
"Ming'er is back too?"
Patriarch Bahrain nodded to Hu Ming with satisfaction.
However, at this moment, the old man holding a fiery red crutch snorted coldly, and an invisible pressure instantly enveloped Hu Ming.
"Bold nonsense."
The Great Elder stood up and scolded Hu Ming angrily, "I just got the news that Hu Yun found Ling Min. Why did you lie?"
Huh?
As soon as these words came out, even Ling Min himself was a little stunned.
Then, he directly refuted the Great Elder and said: "Great Elder, I was indeed saved by Hu Ming..."
"What kind of strength is Hu Ming? Can he save you?"
Of course the Great Elder knew the truth, but in order to target Hu Ming, he didn't care about the truth at all.
"Did you say this on purpose to get him back into the family?"
Buzz!
The terrifying pressure kept squeezing Hu Ming's body, and a crisp sound came from Hu Ming's body.
It could be seen that he was in great pain.
At this moment, the Bahrain patriarch stopped him, "Great Elder, I will investigate this matter clearly..."
"Saving Min'er is a great achievement. I will not make any reward until the investigation is clear."
Hearing this, the great elder waved the fiery red crutch in his hand, and the invisible pressure disappeared instantly.
"Hu Ming, haven't you already left Bahrain City? Why are you coming back?" the great elder asked.
After a brief silence, Hu Ming raised his head and looked directly at the great elder.
